ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, shareholders, authorized signatories, senior managers, and material agents must be screened using fuzzy matching against the domestic PBOC politically exposed persons database, the People's Bank of China anti-money laundering suspicious transaction reporting standards, and China's sanctions announcements issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The program must also screen against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, the U.S. OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Non-SDN lists, and applicable EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions wherever cross-border payment rails exist. Each positive PEP, sanctions, or adverse-media hit requires enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification, written escalation to the AML compliance committee, and mandatory continuous monitoring with a 48-hour action deadline.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR Enterprise Name Independent Declaration and Registration System, integrated with the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System administered by the State Administration for Market Regulation and its provincial counterparts
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Registered legal names must be in simplified Chinese characters. The statutory four-tier naming structure is: administrative division, distinctive trade name, industry or operating characteristics, and legal form or organizational type. Pure English names, pinyin-only names, and traditional Chinese characters are not accepted as the legal registered name. For a Sino-foreign joint venture, the Chinese trade name may be a phonetically transliterated rendition of the foreign investor's name, and a supplementary foreign-language name may be recorded for reference only. The Chinese name controls for all registration, licensing, banking, and tax purposes.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant must first obtain the written rejection notice and legal grounds from the SAMR enterprise name portal. Within 60 days of receipt, a written administrative reconsideration petition must be filed either with the next-higher SAMR authority or with the same-level people's government where the rejection was issued by a district or municipal bureau. The petition must attach the original submission number, the rejected four-tier name, the statutory basis for permissible use, the proposed corrective alternative, and all supporting corporate and authentication documents. If the reconsideration authority upholds the rejection, the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit in the competent people's court within 15 days after service of the reconsideration decision. For sensitive-token names requiring ministerial approval, the applicant must submit the approval letter from the competent central ministry before filing any appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office and commercial mailbox addresses are rejected by PRC local market regulation authorities, tax authorities, and licensed banks for this industry. Because the enterprise operates as an international student placement and golden visa residence advisory business, it is consumer-facing and subject to enhanced AML KYC expectations. The registered office must be a physical commercial premises in the administrative district where the joint venture is registered, evidenced by a valid lease or certificate of ownership, a visible company sign, and unrestricted access for authorized inspectors. Co-working space may be accepted only if it provides a dedicated unit, a separate lease, a floor and suite number, and a compliance inspection room. A P.O. box, virtual office, or commercial mail forwarding address will fail SAMR registration, tax registration, statutory license review, and bank account opening due diligence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Unannounced physical inspection risk is high for this licensed consumer-facing advisory business, quantified at approximately 65-80% probability within the first 12 months of operation. The inspection checklist includes: registered signage matching the Chinese enterprise name; valid lease agreement and floor/unit mapping; presence of the designated compliance officer and principal responsible person; employee labor contracts and social insurance records; published fee schedule and client service agreements; escrow and wire-transfer records; AML/CFT training records; and the statutory license displayed at the premises. Municipal tax bureaus and market regulation authorities may coordinate spot checks on short written or no notice. Non-compliance with the physical-presence requirement can result in deregistration of the address, administrative fines, inability to issue receipts, and frozen bank accounts.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision effective 1 July 2024), Articles 23–50, 63–75, and 85–100; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2020), Articles 4, 8–14; Implementation Regulations of the Foreign Investment Law (2020)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local Municipal Market Supervision Administration branch where the registered office is located
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Establishment Registration Application Form (SAMR standard form) submitted through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and the integrated foreign investment reporting portal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None under general Chinese Company Law for a consulting limited liability company; however, the subscribed registered capital stated in the Articles of Association must be fully paid within five years of incorporation under Company Law Article 47, and any paid-in capital contribution must be deposited into a corporate bank account and supported by a capital contribution receipt or capital verification report where the Articles or the bank require it. No blocked escrow account is mandated by the national statutes.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF CN_JV_LTD (SINO-FOREIGN EQUITY JOINT VENTURE LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY) — PASSED BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE FOUNDING DIRECTORS ON THE DATE OF INCORPORATION: WHEREAS, all proceedings and agendas have been duly waived and the corporate records shall reflect this resolution as if adopted at a formally convened board meeting. RESOLVED, that the Board unanimously approves the subscription of share capital as fully set forth in the Articles of Association and the Joint Venture Contract, namely such number and class of ordinary shares as subscribed by each founding shareholder, representing one hundred percent (100%) of the registered capital, and that the Chief Financial Officer or authorized bank signatory shall open a capital contribution account and deposit all funds into a bank account designated for the company. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Board authorizes and designates the General Manager together with the legal representative to execute all agreements, bank account opening forms, online banking mandates, foreign exchange registration, and escrow instructions for client funds with branches of qualified commercial banks, and that any two of the following authorized signatories may jointly sign for payments: the General Manager, the Deputy General Manager, and the Chief Financial Officer. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the company shall be adopted as the premises lawfully leased or owned, namely the address stated in the business license, and shall be the place for statutory records, tax notices, and legal process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Board appoints the nominee named in the incorporation filings as Executive Director and Legal Representative, appoints a Supervisory Nominee to the supervisory board, and appoints the General Manager, Chief Financial Officer, and Compliance Officer as statutory officers responsible for regulatory compliance, anti-money-laundering procedures, and reporting. RESOLVED, that all officers, managers, and agents be, and they hereby are, empowered and directed to execute, deliver, file, and record any documents, pay any applicable taxes, and to take every lawful action necessary to carry out the intent of this resolution. This resolution is effective from the date of adoption and remains in force until amended or rescinded by a subsequent board resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration name reservation and foreign investor pre-screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) enterprise name reservation platform and local municipal Market Supervision Administration online window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal application for pre-approval of the proposed company name and business scope through the National Integrated Government Service Platform. The proposed name must include a company type indicator such as limited liability company and must not infringe on registered trademarks or contain prohibited language. Foreign investors must provide identity or corporate existence documentation, and such documents must be notarized in the home jurisdiction and legalized by a Chinese consulate or accepted under the Apostille Convention where applicable. The filing must explicitly state the scope as international study-abroad placement, immigration advisory, and visa consulting services corresponding to ISIC 7810 and NAICS 541199. Once approved, the name reservation is valid for six months and may be extended.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name list in order of preference, minimum three alternatives
Notarized and legalized passports or corporate registration certificates of all shareholders
Certificates of good standing or bank reference letters for foreign investors
Power of attorney executed by all shareholders in favor of the incorporation agent
Detailed business scope description mapped to ISIC 7810 / NAICS 541199
Preliminary articles of association in Chinese
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is queried or suspended, the applicant may add distinguishing characters or industry descriptors and resubmit the same application on the SAMR portal, attaching a written explanation and the AMR objection notice. Administrative reconsideration is available if the name is rejected on clearly erroneous grounds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of statutory establishment registration and incorporation documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration corporate registration desk and National Foreign Investment Information System of the Ministry of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation package online or in person at the local AMR service hall, including the Articles of Association, the Joint Venture Contract, the list of legal representatives and board members, capital contribution schedules, and the lease or ownership proof of the registered office. The foreign investor must concurrently submit a Foreign Investment Information Report through the integrated reporting system. The AMR will examine compliance with the Company Law, the Foreign Investment Law, and the negative list for foreign investment. Upon successful review, the AMR issues the unified social credit code and the business license, which constitutes the legal moment of incorporation. The official registration fee is nil, but stamp duty may apply to the registered capital.
required_dossiers: Completed Company Establishment Registration Application Form
Articles of Association signed by all shareholders
Joint Venture Contract signed by the shareholders
Legal representative appointment letter and identity document
Board members and supervisors list with identity certificates
Lease agreement or property ownership certificate for the registered office
Bank receipt of any paid-in capital or capital contribution commitment statement
Foreign Investment Information Report filing receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AMR issues a correction notice, the applicant must revise the defective articles, scope, or officer information within the stated response period, usually ten working days, and resubmit. If the rejection is upheld, a Chinese legal counsel may issue a supplementary legal opinion and file for administrative review with the superior AMR office or apply for mediation through the Foreign Investment complaint mechanism.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration seal engraving, tax registration, and statutory employment registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security authorized seal engraving service, Municipal Tax Service of the State Taxation Administration, and Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after receiving the business license, arrange for engraving of the company common seal, financial seal, legal representative seal, and contract seal at a licensed security engraving enterprise and record the seal impressions with the local Public Security Bureau. Within thirty days, complete tax registration through the electronic tax bureau using the unified social credit code, determine general or small-scale taxpayer status, and register the company for corporate income tax, value-added tax, stamp duty, and payroll withholding obligations. Concurrently, register the entity with social insurance and housing provident fund schemes for future employees. The company must also open a basic RMB bank account and a separate client escrow account at a commercial bank, reporting the opening to the People's Bank of China for anti-money-laundering risk classification.
required_dossiers: Original business license
Taxpayer registration information sheet
Legal representative passport or national identity card
Seal impression record from the engraving enterprise
Articles of Association and JV Contract
Bank account opening application and AML/KYC declaration
Social insurance and provident fund registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is delayed, the company may still operate using the unified social credit code temporarily, but all late filings must be cleared with penalties. If the bank declines the escrow account due to enhanced AML concerns, the company shall select a different designated commercial bank from the approved list and resubmit a strengthened client-money segregation policy within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Operational licensing verification and civil defense / fire compliance clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Emergency Management Bureau, Municipal Fire and Rescue Department, and local ecological and environmental authority for applicability review
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a compliance assessment of the leased office to obtain the fire safety acceptance certificate required for all commercial premises. The certificate verifies that the premises has compliant fire exits, extinguishers, emergency lighting, and evacuation signage under the Law of the PRC on Fire Protection. Because the enterprise is a pure consulting and advisory service with no manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing component, an environmental impact assessment and industrial operating permit are not applicable. The principal statutory operating license is the business license itself. The company must display the business license and fire certificate at the registered office and ensure that any study-abroad or immigration consultants hold applicable professional credentials or have filed with the municipal talent or immigration service registry if local regulations so require.
required_dossiers: Fire safety acceptance certificate or fire inspection record for the office leasehold
Business license copy
Office lease contract and property occupancy permit
Detailed premises floor plan showing fire exits
Declaration of non-polluting activity, if requested
Professional resumes and qualification certificates of immigration or study-abroad consultants
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire inspection fails, the company must correct deficiencies, install or repair fire suppression and detection equipment, and request a re-inspection by the fire department. If an environmental authority erroneously queries the company, the company may submit a statutory declaration that no industrial activity is undertaken, and attach the lease, business scope, and a zero-discharge statement to obtain a formal exemption.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable — pure consulting and advisory enterprise; the general licensing authority is the local Market Supervision Administration and the Municipal Emergency Management Bureau for fire safety, and no industrial or manufacturing licensing board has jurisdiction
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable for industrial operations; the sole statutory operating permit is the Business License of the company, supplemented by the Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate for office occupancy

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) — applicable only if industrial activity is initiated; current project is exempt
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater discharge, zero process VOC emissions, zero hazardous waste generation; domestic sanitary sewage is connected to the municipal public network within the municipal COD and ammonia-nitrogen thresholds; office paper and general waste are handled under the municipal solid waste regulatory regime.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety acceptance certificate under the Law of the PRC on Fire Protection and local implementing rules is mandatory for commercial office occupancy. Structural load inspection is not applicable for a standard office lease within design load limits. Work safety clearance under the Work Safety Law of the PRC is required, including evacuation planning, fire extinguishers, employee safety training, and an anti-money-laundering and compliance officer appointment for the consulting business.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China; the official electronic filing and tax identification portal is the State Taxation Administration Electronic Taxpayer Service System, operated as the national e-tax platform under the STA
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Complete incorporation of the Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture with the State Administration for Market Regulation and obtain the Business License, which carries the Unified Social Credit Code. Step 2: Within 30 days after issuance of the Business License, access the provincial State Taxation Administration Electronic Taxpayer Service System and complete tax registration and tax-related accounting information filing, supplying the Business License, Articles of Association, legal representative identity evidence, registered premises proof, financial and accounting system statement, and the investment filing or approval evidence required under the Foreign Investment Law. Step 3: The tax authority creates the enterprise record in the national taxpayer database and the Unified Social Credit Code becomes the enterprise Taxpayer Identification Number for both VAT and Corporate Income Tax. Step 4: Complete the payroll taxpayer registration for employment withholding obligations, including individual income tax, social insurance, and housing fund registration details. Step 5: For cross-border payments to non-resident shareholders or counterparties, register the withholding tax obligation through the e-tax platform under the non-resident enterprise withholding rules; a foreign non-resident enterprise that only holds an equity interest in the JV does not require a separate Chinese TIN. Step 6: Activate the VAT invoice issuance qualification in the STA digital electronic invoice system and arrange for the issuance of 0% and 6% rated VAT invoices consistent with the JV's study abroad and immigration advisory service scope.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None under the US check-the-box concept; China has no entity classification election for PRC-incorporated enterprises. The Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture is classified as a resident enterprise subject to entity-level Corporate Income Tax on worldwide income. The only relevant statutory election is the VAT election between small-scale VAT taxpayer treatment and general VAT taxpayer treatment when annual taxable turnover is below CNY 5,000,000; no separate hybrid mismatch entity election exists, and PRC anti-hybrid rules apply to cross-border arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT), the PRC invoice-based consumption tax; the general headline goods rate is 13%, the applicable VAT rate for ISIC 7810 consulting/advisory and visa services is 6%, and qualifying exported services are taxed at 0%
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VAT registration is mandatory for all business-registered entities within 30 days of incorporation; annual taxable turnover above CNY 5,000,000 triggers mandatory registration as a general VAT taxpayer, and entities below this threshold may choose small-scale taxpayer treatment with a reduced levy applicable to small-scale VAT taxpayers
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The JV must enroll in the State Taxation Administration Digital Electronic Invoice system; all VAT invoices must be issued under STA-controlled serial numbers, carry the national unified invoice verification code and anti-fraud digital stamp, and be transmitted in real time to the STA Golden Tax monitoring system. General VAT taxpayers issuing special VAT invoices must maintain the prescribed invoice equipment or API clearance connection, and each special invoice must be reported and validated through the e-tax platform before the buyer can claim input VAT credit; fapiao issuance without genuine commercial substance is prohibited as anti-fraud enforcement.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The 0% export VAT rate applies to goods physically exported from China and to qualifying cross-border services supplied by a Chinese resident enterprise to an overseas recipient where the service is consumed entirely outside China. For ISIC 7810 study abroad, immigration and visa advisory services, zero-rating is substantiated when the contractual counterparty is a non-resident client, the service is supplied to and used by a foreign student or foreign applicant in a destination jurisdiction, the consideration is received from abroad, and the advisory activity is documented by overseas university placement records or foreign immigration authority outcomes. The taxpayer must file the zero-rated turnover in the VAT return and submit the contract, foreign exchange receipt, overseas evidence and zero-rated VAT invoice through the e-tax workflow for statutory verification.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Goods Declaration Form for any physical goods export (a service-only export does not require customs goods declaration but must maintain the equivalent cross-border service documentation)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill where documents or incidental materials are shipped

Bank-generated inward remittance certificate / Foreign Exchange Collection Confirmation issued by the designated bank, functionally equivalent to an Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC), showing receipt amount matching the contract and the zero-rated invoice value
Signed cross-border service agreement with the overseas commissioning client, including payment and jurisdiction clauses
0% rated VAT invoice (fapiao) issued through the STA digital electronic invoice system with the zero-rate indicator

Overseas consumption evidence for study abroad and immigration advisory services, including university offer letters, enrollment confirmations, visa approval letters, destination-country residence permits and immigration case records
Residency documentation of the foreign client, such as passport copy, overseas tax residency certificate or a foreign utility/address record, proving non-PRC service consumption
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA performs data-matching audits between VAT returns, zero-rated invoice ledgers, customs records and bank foreign exchange receipts. If zero-rating is disallowed due to missing overseas consumption, false documentation, or failure to repatriate foreign exchange within the statutory period, the tax authority re-characterizes the supply at the standard service rate of 6%, collects the under-declared VAT, imposes daily late-payment interest from the original filing date, and applies an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax under the Tax Administration Law. Fraudulent export zero-rating or invoice chains attract retrospective clawbacks, tax-credit blacklisting, license suspension, and criminal liability for tax fraud, invoice fraud, or foreign exchange evasion; recovery periods extend up to five years in ordinary underpayment cases and are unlimited in fraud or evasion cases.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC), with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) as the implementing authority for foreign-exchange regulations
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is not fully convertible on the capital account. China satisfies current-account convertibility for bona fide trade, services, and certain transfers, but inbound equity or loan capital can only enter after SAFE registration and through a designated bank account. A Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture must complete Ministry of Commerce filing or approval, obtain the foreign-investment certificate or record, deposit the contributed capital in an FDI capital account, and settle the foreign currency into RMB only after the commercial bank has performed a genuinity check on the underlying contract, transaction purpose, and corporate ownership records. Profit and dividend remittance to foreign shareholders is treated as a current-account item after corporate income tax is settled; the remitting bank will demand audited financial statements, a tax-payment certificate, board resolution, sponsor letter, and an FX payment application with a proper SAFE transaction code. In practice, remittance can be delayed by tax clearance inspection, transfer-pricing documentation, or discrepancy between the visa-advisory billing scope and the actual services rendered. Therefore, medium-term liquidity planning must respect a clearing cycle of 4-8 weeks, and capital repatriation must never be assumed on-demand.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export foreign-exchange proceeds received by the JV must be repatriated to China through a designated foreign-exchange bank within 180 days from the date of export customs declaration unless a SAFE-approved offshore retention facility is in place. Upon collection, the entity may either retain the proceeds in an export-receipts foreign-currency account or voluntarily settle them into RMB; no fixed percentage is currently mandated by statute for conversion, but the bank will verify the export declaration, invoices, packing list, logistics record, and receipt maturity to prevent circular trade or fake-export fraud.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Fund Escrow Account and Basic Deposit Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low for onshore Chinese treasury operations. Offshore fintech EMIs such as Wise, Revolut, and Airwallex lack a PBOC banking licence and cannot lawfully provide CNY settlement, SAFE reporting, FDI capital verification, or statutory audit-ready account statements inside mainland China. The JV may use such platforms only for incidental offshore marketing spend or to pay non-China vendors in a low-value current-account trail, but the primary capital injection, escrow, and profit-repatriation rails must run through a licensed domestic tier-1 commercial bank; otherwise the SAFE and PBOC supervision will deem the transaction unverifiable and the JV could face foreign-exchange violation fines and account freezing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: PBOC anti-money-laundering rules require the legal representative and at least one board-authorized director or supervisor to appear physically at the bank branch for a face-to-face KYC interview and biometric capture. Where the foreign director cannot travel, the bank will accept a notarized, legalized power of attorney authorizing a China-based CFO or legal counsel to attend the branch, but a statutory director must still complete a live video interview with the bank's compliance officer. Remote consular proxy opening is tolerated only when the identity is certified by the Chinese embassy or consulate abroad and the bank confirms the corporate registration data matching the JV licence and SAFE record.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medium-risk immigration-consulting business model with large client retainer flows and no physical collateral
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the PRC business licence explicitly covering study-abroad and immigration advisory services, the Ministry of Education or cultural sector licence or filing certificate, licensed consultant employment contracts and social-security records, standard client agreements and refund policy, university or visa-body cooperation contracts, and audited financial statements for the previous three fiscal years.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity in ultimate beneficial ownership through multi-layer Sino-foreign holding vehicles or nominee shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit SAFE and Ministry of Commerce FDI registration record, formation agreement, articles of association, capital contribution schedule, notarized passports of all individuals with 10% or more ownership, criminal-records and politically-exposed-person declarations, corporate registry chain showing no bearer shares, and a signed UBO statement confirming no undisclosed beneficial interests.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between the declared trade purpose code and inbound settlement of client fees as capital or consultancy revenue
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide bank statements with narrative explanations, sample invoices and payment receipts, end-to-end service agreements with clients, proof of student university applications and visa appointment records, sworn declaration of business use, and SAFE transaction-code reconciliation showing all fee inflows classified under the correct current-account consultancy-services category and all equity injections under FDI capital code.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cash, third-party payment collection, or round-tripping risks in the education-visa agency book
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: File an internal AML programme, the complete KYC checklist used with clients, source-of-funds declarations, six months of account-holder-bank statements, PRC corporate tax clearance certificate, audit report, a certificate of no undue public-deposit exposure, documented student-agency fee collection policies, and staff AML training records for the compliance committee.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections from the foreign shareholder must be remitted through high-quality SWIFT MT103 messages into the FDI Capital Account of the JV with a designated tier-1 bank; each remittance must carry a SAFE-compliant purpose code for inbound direct-investment equity and reference the SAFE and Ministry of Commerce registration number. After receipt, the bank will confirm the source and perform RMB settlement only on the basis of the JV's approved capital usage plan; a Chinese certified public accountant must then issue a capital verification report. For operating liquidity, the JV should maintain a separate current-account RMB ledger and route any current-account consultancy fee inflow under the cross-border consultancy-services BoP code, never co-mingling with capital settle.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements and client-client obligations should be cleared by SWIFT MT103 or MT202 direct wires for urgent retainer refunds; by commercial documentary letters of credit for large, authenticated escrow obligations linked to universities or visa providers; and by documentary collections (documents against payment or acceptance) for lower-value, service-completion-based disbursements. Every outbound payment needs an underlying contract and invoice, proof of service delivery, supporting tax-payment or withholding certificate, and a bank-side SAFE export-payment reporting record; the KYC file must remain current before the payment order is released.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore RMB/FX plain-vanilla deliverable forwards are permissible only where the JV holds a genuine current-account or capital-account FX exposure evidenced by trade invoices, capital conversion schedules, or an approved foreign-debt contract with a bank-issued ISDA or NAFMII master agreement.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible as onshore instruments; they can be traded only in offshore CNH markets and must be segregated from the Chinese JV's onshore treasury books.

Cross-currency interest-rate swaps and plain-vanilla FX options with an embedded bona fide exposure are permitted under SAFE risk-need testing, but speculative hedge-only trades without an underlying balance-sheet exposure are prohibited and will be treated as unlicensed cross-border derivatives.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report Filing via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local Market Supervision Administration; data synchronized with Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) for foreign investment information reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 each calendar year, covering the immediately preceding financial year as of December 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by June 30 results in inclusion in the Operating Anomaly List; failure to rectify within three years leads to inclusion in the Serious Illegal and Dishonest List and administrative revocation of the business license

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Information Report (renminbi-denominated report under the foreign investment information reporting system)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) jointly with Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM), submitted through the annual report portal of the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 each calendar year applicable to all foreign-invested enterprises including Sino-foreign equity joint ventures
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate filing triggers a warning and correction order from SAMR; refusal to correct may result in a penalty of up to RMB 200,000 for the enterprise plus personal liability on directors or the person in charge, and potential inclusion in the credit abnormality list

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Settlement and Final Payment Filing, including the Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form A/Form B) with attached financial statements and related party transaction reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA), administered by the local competent tax authority of the enterprise
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 31 immediately following the end of each tax year (tax year ends December 31); enterprises with foreign investment must also submit the annual foreign investment information form if cross-border transactions exist
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of RMB 2,000 per month or partial month up to RMB 20,000; underpayment penalty of 0.05% per day on overdue tax from the due date; collection and administrative enforcement measures apply after three months of failure to pay

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Individual Income Tax Consolidated Filing and Withholding Reconciliation Report for employees and directors
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA), local tax service bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 for individual income tax annual reconciliation of comprehensive income; monthly or bi-monthly withholding declaration by the enterprise as withholding agent throughout the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of RMB 2,000 maximum for obstruction; daily surcharge of 0.05% on unpaid tax; criminal liability possible for fraudulent withholding or misappropriation of withheld taxes

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Registered Address and Business License Annual Inspection Certification (reported via the integrated annual report platform, covering business license, social insurance, and statistical declarations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and human resources and social security authority through integrated annual reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit timely annual report triggers restriction from handling business registration changes and inclusion in the list of enterprises with abnormal operations; administrative strike-off after three consecutive years of non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Exchange Business Reporting under the Foreign Investment Information Report and SAFE registration renewal if capital account foreign exchange records are active
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), through banks designated by SAFE or the enterprise's settlement bank
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by June 30 for foreign investment information reporting; ad hoc SAFE registration modifications within 30 days of any equity or capital structure change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative warning and fines under the Foreign Exchange Control Regulations; exchange suspension or penalty up to 5% of the illegal amount for failure to report foreign exchange receipts or payments

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Sino-foreign equity joint ventures in China, regardless of size, must prepare audited annual financial statements and obtain an audit report from a qualified Chinese Certified Public Accountant firm licensed by the Ministry of Finance. There is no turnover or balance-sheet exemption for foreign-invested enterprises. Additional mandatory audit triggers apply without size threshold where the company has public interest significance, applies for bank credit, obtains foreign debt, experiences equity transfer, or is selected for statutory audit by SAMR or tax authority. For purely domestic private companies outside the foreign-invested category, compulsory statutory audit triggers are: (a) total balance sheet assets exceeding RMB 30 million; (b) annual turnover exceeding RMB 30 million; or (c) average headcount exceeding 100 persons for the relevant year, with any single trigger making the company a medium or large enterprise requiring an independent audit report.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Chinese Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE/CAS), substantially converged with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS); foreign-invested enterprises may apply the full Chinese Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises framework, and where cross-border reporting to foreign shareholders requires, the parent may prepare a reconciliation to IFRS, but the statutory statutory audit must be issued under Chinese CAS with the auditor licensed in China

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Beneficial Owners of Market Entities, China has rolled out dedicated beneficial ownership information filing: the enterprise must file beneficial owner information with SAMR within 30 days of formation and must submit a renewed beneficial ownership confirmation through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System when a change occurs, with no separate annual recurring beneficial-owner filing; nevertheless the annual report filing itself must update shareholding, capital, and control information annually by June 30. Any transfer of equity or change in ultimate beneficial owner, direct shareholder, registered capital, or control rights must be reported to SAMR within 30 days of the change. The company must maintain and continuously update its internal register of shareholders and beneficial ownership records, and cannot rely solely on an annual cycle for ownership changes.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors, Supervisors and Senior Management
Register of Charges/Mortgages pledged on equity or assets
Minute Book of Shareholders' Resolutions and Board Resolutions
Register of Beneficial Owners (in cities implementing beneficial owner filing under pilot measures)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: For a China market-based maintenance budget, registered office use under a leasing arrangement typically ranges from $2,500 to $12,000 per year depending on city tier, premium building classification and whether the lease provides assistance for the Market Supervision inspection of the registered address; a registered agent arrangement used only for document acceptance and compliance coordination ranges from $1,200 to $6,000 per year.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: For a Sino-foreign equity joint venture in the study-abroad and immigration-visa advisory sector with estimated annual revenues of $0.5 million to $10 million, a certified China CPA audit fee typically ranges from $3,500 to $15,000 per year, including issuance of the statutory audit report, supporting statement of foreign exchange related items where bank needs arise, and preparation of the annual report attachment to the tax filing; group-level coordinated audits with international parent reporting requirements may reach $18,000 to $25,000 per year.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Eligible Small Low-Profit Enterprise: effective 5% on taxable income up to CNY 3,000,000 (taxable income reduced to 25% and taxed at 20%, per Notice 2023 No. 12); High-and-New Technology Enterprise: 15%; Non-resident enterprise without a permanent establishment deriving China-source income: final withholding tax at 10%; qualifying R&D expenses may benefit from a 100% super deduction. No patent box regime applies to study-abroad or immigration-consulting intangibles.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 (Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return, Class A) filed electronically via the State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Taxation / Golden Tax System)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly prepayments due within 15 days after each quarter-end; final annual return and balancing payment due on or before 31 May of the year following the fiscal year-end (5 months after 31 December for calendar-year filers)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from services rendered, including study abroad placement fees, immigration program advisory fees, golden visa consulting fees, university application fees, document preparation charges and all related ancillary income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Aggregate all PRC and foreign-source gross income; a resident JV must declare worldwide income. Convert foreign currency using the annual average exchange rate published by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. Exclude VAT receipts but report VAT separately. Reconcile with bank statements, escrow releases and wire transfer records. Do not net commissions or payments to overseas universities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs of providing services, including salaries of counsellors, university liaison expenses, admission processing costs, visa application direct costs and outsourced service charges attributable to revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only substantiated costs evidenced by contracts, invoices, time logs and payroll records. Payments to foreign related parties must satisfy the arm's length standard and transfer pricing documentation thresholds. A commission to an overseas agent with no economic substance will be disallowed and may be recharacterized as a dividend subject to 10% withholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible PRC turnover-related taxes excluding enterprise income tax and VAT itself; includes city maintenance and construction tax, education surcharge, local education surcharge, stamp duty and other levies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not deduct the enterprise income tax liability, the 10% dividend withholding tax, or penalties. VAT collected from clients is neither revenue nor deductible cost. Ensure tax surcharges are computed on actual VAT paid, not on gross receipts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing, advertising, online promotion, lead generation, overseas exhibitions, sales staff commissions and client acquisition costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border digital marketing fees paid to an affiliate must be supported by contracts, proof of performance and arm's length pricing. If the recipient is located in a zero-tax jurisdiction and lacks employees and business functions, the fee will be disregarded for CIT purposes and may be treated as a disguised profit distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Rent, utilities, general management salaries, professional fees, insurance, office supplies and other general overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees charged by a foreign ultimate parent are deductible only to the extent the parent demonstrates actual services, benefits to the Chinese JV and arm's length fees. Excessive or purely allocation-based charges are caught by CIT Law Article 41 and Article 47 and may be treated as dividends subject to WHT. Ensure compensation to directors is approved by the board and properly taxed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest expense, bank charges, foreign exchange losses and other financing costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to a non-resident related lender is subject to thin capitalization limits: debt-to-equity ratio 2:1 generally, 5:1 for financial institutions. Interest must be arm's length and substantiated. Gross interest remitted to non-resident lenders is subject to 10% WHT unless reduced by an applicable DTA; failure to withhold triggers a 50%-300% penalty under TCAL Article 69.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credit for foreign income taxes paid on foreign-source income already included in Box 1.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A resident JV may claim a foreign tax credit for taxes paid abroad on foreign-source income, subject to the PRC foreign tax credit formula and ceilings. This is not available for taxes paid to tax havens on income lacking real economic substance; the tax authority may reject credit if the arrangement fails the beneficial ownership or reasonable business purpose tests.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 (Line: Taxable Income and Tax Payable / Overpayment Adjustment)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable income after loss carryforwards, deductions, exemptions and tax credits, and the resulting annual corporate income tax liability after prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile total tax payable and prepayments; if the foreign shareholder is entitled to DTA relief on dividends, apply the correct domestic WHT rate only after treaty clearance, but do not confuse the JV's CIT liability with the shareholder's dividend WHT. Any under-declared taxable income above RMB 50,000 and exceeding 10% of tax payable triggers Criminal Law Article 201 exposure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: TCAL Article 62 imposes a fine of RMB 2,000 (up to RMB 10,000 if serious); late payment accrues 0.05% daily surcharge under TCAL Article 32. Evasion through false returns (TCAL Article 63) attracts a fine of 50%-500% of the unpaid tax. Criminal fraud thresholds under Criminal Law Article 201: tax evaded ≥ RMB 50,000 and >10% of tax payable leads to imprisonment up to 3 years; if the amount is huge (≥ RMB 250,000 and >30%), imprisonment up to 7 years. A guilty JV may also lose preferential treatment, be blacklisted and have bank accounts frozen, with responsible directors subject to exit bans.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% for dividends distributed to non-resident corporate shareholders under EIT Law Articles 3 and 37; treaty reduction to 5% is common for a shareholder owning at least 25% of the distributing company under several Chinese DTAs (e.g. Mainland-Hong Kong arrangement, China-Singapore treaty); dividends paid to a resident Chinese corporate shareholder are tax-exempt under EIT Law Article 26.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a DTA-reduced WHT rate, the recipient non-resident shareholder must obtain an official Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the home-country tax authority, provide a Beneficial Owner Declaration confirming direct and beneficial ownership of the dividends, disclose the full ownership chain and demonstrate a genuine business purpose. The Chinese withholding agent (the JV) must file the treaty benefit claim in the e-Tax system, attach the TRC, constitutional documents, share register, tax registration proofs, board resolutions approving distribution, and a beneficial ownership analysis. The tax authority reviews whether the recipient has the power and substance to use and enjoy the income; if the recipient is a mere shell/conduit, treaty relief is denied and the 10% WHT must be withheld and paid. Until the treaty benefit is approved, the withholding agent should withhold at the statutory 10%; a refund or set-off may be claimed after over-withholding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory WHT on outbound interest and royalties to non-resident enterprises is 10% (final withholding, no PE). DTA rates vary by jurisdiction: interest is commonly reduced to 10% under the China-US treaty, 7.5% under China-Singapore, or 7% under Mainland-Hong Kong; royalties are commonly reduced to 10% or 5% depending on treaty and IP type, with Mainland-Hong Kong applying 7% for certain intellectual property royalties. Cross-border technical service fees may be treated as service revenue subject to 6% VAT and, if an overseas service provider performs the service in China and creates a permanent establishment, that PE is taxed at 25% on net profits.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File threshold: service-related party transactions at or above CNY 40,000,000 per year; intangible or financial asset transfers at or above CNY 100,000,000; tangible property transfers at or above CNY 200,000,000. Master File is required when aggregate annual related-party transactions reach CNY 1,000,000,000 or when qualifying cross-border related-party transactions exceed CNY 200,000,000. Country-by-Country Reporting triggers at group consolidated revenue of CNY 5,500,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not have a standalone Economic Substance Regulations code, but EIT Law Article 47 (GAAR), SAT Public Notice 42 of 2016 and OECD-aligned substance-over-form tests regulate economic substance. For a study-abroad/immigration-visa consultancy JV, Core Income-Generating Activities include client identification and contracting, due diligence on universities/embassies, preparation of visa applications, service delivery, risk assumption and post-placement compliance. Profit must be allocated to the entity performing functions and controlling risks; a shell subsidiary in Hong Kong or Cayman holding invoices without employees, premises, functions or decision-making will be disregarded and the income reattributed to the Chinese JV. Transactions with zero-tax non-resident affiliates are subject to rigorous beneficial ownership testing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion – False Booking of Cross-Border Consulting Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting study-abroad placement fees, immigration advisory fees and visa service commissions received from clients, foreign universities or resettlement partners, or diverting those receipts to offshore bank accounts without recording them in the Chinese JV's books; using fictitious service invoices from shell entities to inflate deductions; under-declaring taxable income in the Form A100000 by more than 10% of actual tax due and in an amount exceeding RMB 50,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TCAL Article 63: tax authority recovers the underpaid tax and imposes a fine from 50% to 500% of the tax evaded. Criminal Law Article 201: imprisonment up to 3 years for a relatively large amount (≥ RMB 50,000 and >10% of tax payable), and up to 7 years for a huge amount (≥ RMB 250,000 and >30%). If fake VAT invoices are used, Criminal Law Article 205 imposes penalties up to life imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, the legal representative and the chief financial officer who order, participate in or knowingly approve the false bookings are personally liable for civil restitution of unpaid taxes and losses; the tax authority lists them in the serious dishonest taxpayer blacklist, triggering travel and exit bans, restrictive asset transfers and banking penalties; criminal conviction may result in confiscation of personal assets and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax and Treaty Abuse on Outbound Profit Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying a dividend to a foreign parent without withholding the 10% non-resident enterprise income tax; applying a DTA-reduced rate using a foreign shareholder that lacks a valid Tax Residency Certificate or lacks beneficial ownership (e.g. a Hong Kong or Cayman conduit with no actual management activities); or reclassifying a dividend as a 'management fee' or 'service charge' solely to avoid withholding obligations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TCAL Article 69: a withholding agent that fails to withhold and remit is fined 50%-300% of the unwithheld tax; late payment surcharge of 0.05% per day under TCAL Article 32; EIT Law Article 37 imposes the final 10% WHT on outbound dividends. False treaty claims using forged certificates invoke criminal forgery penalties under Criminal Law Article 280.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorized the non-withholding or the abusive treaty claim become personally liable for the unpaid tax and penalties if the JV cannot settle; company assets held by family trusts or relatives may be pierced and recovered; personal travel bans and border-exit control apply; a criminal conviction for tax avoidance or forgery leads to imprisonment and disqualification from holding director positions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Shell Company No-Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Executing circular or excessive related-party payments to an offshore affiliate with no employees, offices, business functions or audited accounts; paying gold-plated marketing fees or exaggerated commissions to a Hong Kong or Cayman affiliate while the Chinese JV retains all client relationships, staff, contracts and decision-making; failing to prepare a Local File when related-party service transactions reach CNY 40,000,000; booking thin margins in China so that profits accumulate in zero-tax jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: EIT Law Article 41 and SAT Notice 42 authorize the tax authority to make an arm's length adjustment; Implementation Regulations Articles 121-122 impose back interest equal to the benchmark lending rate plus 5 percentage points on the additional tax; EIT Law Article 47 GAAR permits recharacterization of shell transactions; if the mispricing is reflected in fraudulent returns, TCAL Article 63 imposes a fine of 50%-500% of the underpaid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve self-dealing related-party payments breach PRC Company Law Article 148 (duty of loyalty and care) and may be sued for personal restitution of company losses; the corporate veil may be pierced where assets were transferred to related parties or to the director's own accounts; personal assets can be frozen to satisfy tax-impairments; travel bans, blacklisting and criminal liability for fraudulent invoice issuance or embezzlement may follow.
